gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-noto-sans-ta: Outrun Future is all synthwave swagger: wide-set letters, one traceable outline. Noto Sans Tangsa, a sans with wide, inviting round letters and short ascender stems, stays approachable paragraph after paragraph.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-noto-sans-te: Outrun Future traces one constant-width outline, wide-set and unmistakably synthwave. It grabs attention, while Noto Sans Telugu handles the steadier job, with a high midline and counters open to the outside.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-noto-sans-th: Outrun Future spaces its letters wide and traces a single constant-width outline. But Noto Sans Thai Looped brings tall, bold-looking lowercase and spacious gaps at its curve terminals.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-numans: Outrun Future draws a constant-width outline you could trace with a finger, letters set well apart. Numans follows with a modern sans, its tight-coiled lowercase and widely tracked letters giving the heading room to lead.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-open-sans: Outrun Future is pure synthwave, wide-set and drawn at a single weight. Open Sans, a contemporary sans-serif with bulky lowercase, reads smoothly over a full page with no clogged curves.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-oxygen: Oxygen reads contemporary and clean, its curves never closing back on themselves and its lowercase nearly matching the capitals. Outrun Future adds the rounded, wide-set synthwave punch on top.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-parkinsans: Outrun Future keeps a constant-width outline you can trace, with letters set wide. Parkinsans, a modern sans-serif with one stroke thickness, stays crisp when shrunk, and that sharpness is the pair's best quality.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-prompt: Outrun Future is wide-set synthwave with a stencil-cut channel of constant weight. Prompt, a sans-serif with oversized small letters and open apertures, holds up line after line without tiring the eye.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-pt-sans-capt: Outrun Future brings ruler-drawn synthwave swagger, wide-set and constant in width. PT Sans Caption then quietly steps in as a sans-serif with unclosed, inviting bowls and big-bodied lowercase letters.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-radio-canada: Radio Canada Big, a sans with a monoline skeleton, sits under the wide-set synthwave of Outrun Future. Radio Canada Big ends its strokes away from the stem and fills the line, so text moves along smoothly.
